title: Single-nucleus chromatin accessibility profiling highlights distinct astrocyte signatures in progressive supranuclear palsy and corticobasal degeneration.
authors: Briel, Nils; Ruf, Viktoria C; Pratsch, Katrin; Roeber, Sigrun; Widmann, Jeannine; Mielke, Janina; Dorostkar, Mario M; Windl, Otto; Arzberger, Thomas; Herms, Jochen; Struebing, Felix L
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单核染色质可及性分析揭示PSP和CBD中星形胶质细胞特异性状态，并利用TF基序富集和机器学习预测TF互作，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测但缺乏三维结构建模与分子模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Tauopathies such as progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) and corticobasal degeneration (CBD) exhibit characteristic neuronal and glial inclusions of hyperphosphorylated Tau (pTau). Although the astrocytic pTau phenotype upon neuropathological examination is the most guiding feature in distinguishing both diseases, regulatory mechanisms controlling their transitions into disease-specific states are poorly understood to date. Here, we provide accessible chromatin data of more than 45,000 single nuclei isolated from the frontal cortex of PSP, CBD, and control individuals. We found a strong association of disease-relevant molecular changes with astrocytes and demonstrate that tauopathy-relevant genetic risk variants are tightly linked to astrocytic chromatin accessibility profiles in the brains of PSP and CBD patients. Unlike the established pathogenesis in the secondary tauopathy Alzheimer disease, microglial alterations were relatively sparse. Transcription factor (TF) motif enrichments in pseudotime as well as modeling of the astrocytic TF interplay suggested a common pTau signature for CBD and PSP that is reminiscent of an inflammatory immediate-early response. Nonetheless, machine learning models also predicted discriminatory features, and we observed marked differences in molecular entities related to protein homeostasis between both diseases. Predicted TF involvement was supported by immunofluorescence analyses in postmortem brain tissue for their highly correlated target genes. Collectively, our data expand the current knowledge on risk gene involvement (e.g., MAPT, MAPK8, and NFE2L2) and molecular pathways leading to the phenotypic changes associated with CBD and PSP.
abstract_zh: 进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）和皮质基底节变性（CBD）等tau蛋白病表现出特征性的神经元和胶质细胞包涵体，其中含有过度磷酸化的Tau蛋白（pTau）。尽管在神经病理学检查中，星形胶质细胞pTau表型是区分这两种疾病最具指导性的特征，但迄今为止，调控其向疾病特异性状态转变的机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们提供了从PSP、CBD和对照个体额叶皮层分离的超过45,000个单核的可及染色质数据。我们发现疾病相关分子变化与星形胶质细胞存在强烈关联，并证明tau蛋白病相关的遗传风险变异与PSP和CBD患者大脑中的星形胶质细胞染色质可及性谱紧密相连。与继发性tau蛋白病阿尔茨海默病中已确立的发病机制不同，小胶质细胞的变化相对稀少。伪时间中的转录因子（TF）基序富集以及星形胶质细胞TF相互作用的建模提示，CBD和PSP存在共同的pTau特征，这类似于炎症性即时早期反应。尽管如此，机器学习模型也预测了区分性特征，我们观察到两种疾病之间与蛋白质稳态相关的分子实体存在显著差异。预测的TF参与得到了死后脑组织中其高度相关靶基因的免疫荧光分析支持。总体而言，我们的数据扩展了当前关于风险基因参与（如MAPT、MAPK8和NFE2L2）以及导致CBD和PSP相关表型变化的分子途径的知识。
